Iconic EQ Two-Handed Very Heavy Melee Weapon (w/ Bladesmith [Barbed] & Haemocide). This weapon cannot be used to make Aimed Shots, but all Attacks from it also have the effects of Burrowing and Explosive Ammunition (including its -2 Attack Check penalty) [Bladesmith + Haemocide]. Cannot accept an additional Weapon Mod (unless it receives the Mod Nexus Tech Upgrade), as both of its Weapon Mod slots are filled.

Variant of: Generic Two-Handed Very Heavy Melee Weapon
Category: Very Expensive
Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Melee
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • Corgo gives no stat line for this one, only "Two-Handed Very Heavy Melee Weapon", so it uses CPR 0.92.4's generic Very Heavy Melee Weapon: 4d6, ROF 2, two-handed.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
